summary: A bilingual Spanish/English community paper where every ad is a full-colour display box: paired red/blue category tabs (EMPLEO | EMPLOYMENT), each box in its own clashing typeface, coloured border and clip art. Loud, handmade and cheerful.

frame.masthead: Royal-blue band: red 2más2KC logo tile, white caps CLASSIFIEDS / Clasificados, phone and email, page number and date at right.

headers.notes: Spanish word on a red tab, English on a blue tab, side by side. PUBLIC ANNOUNCEMENTS gets a green tab.

units.example: RECEPTIONIST / We are looking for a Bi-lingual Receptionist...
units.notes: Each box picks its own border colour (red, blue, teal) and its own font; condensed Times on red, Impact-like heads, bullets.
Cream/yellow fills, rooster logo, condensed bold copy.

units.example: Does advertising work?? IT JUST DID
units.notes: Rainbow-gradient condensed caps, the paper's own ad.
Full-width red block, white condensed caps and italic serif.

type.look: Impact and condensed Times mixed freely

ornaments: small logo repeats as a divider row
notes: The point is the lack of a system: every advertiser brings their own type. A generator family for this should randomise font and border per ad from a pool.
